task: Hill Climb relay. Stage 1: unplug a USB cable from the power strip and put it down away from the strip (then one more the same way). Never plug a cable in. Stage 2: stack the blocks into a free-standing tower more than 4 inches (10 cm) tall. Do not touch the blocks before a cable is unplugged. Stage 3: put coloured golf balls into the white bin, never the white ball or a black ball, without touching the tower. Do not touch the balls before the tower passes.

stages.name: cable_unplug
stages.reason: wrist_r shows the strip's ports empty and an orange-cord plug lying loose beside the strip, so at least one plug is fully out. The right gripper sensor reads nearly shut with no squeeze torque, so it holds nothing. Per the rules a loose plug is done and must not be regrabbed. The strip was not pushed or dragged.

stages.name: cable_put_down
stages.reason: Right gripper sensor reads 0.00 with no squeeze torque, so it is empty and open. The unplugged orange cable lies on the table to the right, away from the power strip, and clear of the tower and balls.

stages.name: arms_clear
stages.reason: Both grippers are commanded open and neither is squeezing anything. The right arm is raised at the right edge, clear of the power strip, cables and blocks. Both cables were unplugged earlier and are not in either gripper.
